heading: A league that puts kids first

items.title: Everyone plays
items.text: Every soccer and flag football player is on the field for at least half of every game. Cheerleaders are part of the whole game day.

items.title: Affordable
items.text: One registration fee covers the season and the uniform kit, with a sibling discount for families.

items.title: Low commitment
items.text: One weeknight practice and one Saturday game a week. That's it.

items.title: Safe and supportive
items.text: Trained coaches, balanced teams, and a low-pressure environment where kids can try, fail, and try again.

items.title: Rooted in faith
items.text: Built on Christian principles, with coaches who model character on and off the field.

items.title: Real growth
items.text: Kids build skills, confidence, teamwork, and friendships that last past the final whistle.
